ratios.quote: However, our actual leverage was 5.67 , which is below previously applicable maximum leverage of 6.00 .
Our actual interest coverage for the four consecutive quarters ended March 31, 2026 was 3.10 , which is above the minimum interest coverage of 2.00 .
Our actual maximum secured leverage ratio for the four consecutive quarters ended March 31, 2026 was 1.27 , which is below the newly established maximum secured leverage ratio of 3.50 .

parsed.notes: Under the April 16, 2026 amendment (Amendment No 6), the maximum leverage ratio was not tested at March 31, 2026; the 6.00 limit shown is the previously applicable maximum, given for comparison only. The leverage limit rises to 6.75 after the first three quarters of 2026 through December 31, 2027, then steps down to 3.75 by March 31, 2029. The interest coverage minimum is 2.00 through June 30, 2027, then steps up to 3.50 by March 31, 2029. The 3.50 secured leverage maximum is newly established by the amendment. The company states it was in compliance with all covenants at March 31, 2026.
